# EventHub - Event Registration & Business Listing Platform

A comprehensive full-stack web application for event registration, news, job listings, business directories, and catering services.

## Project Setup

- [x] Project scaffolded with React frontend and Node.js backend
- [x] Database models configured for events, jobs, news, business listings
- [x] API routes created for all main features
- [x] Responsive UI components with creative design

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18, Tailwind CSS, Axios
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js
- **Database**: MongoDB
- **Authentication**: JWT

## Running the Project

### Backend
```bash
cd backend
npm install
npm run dev
```

### Frontend
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm start
```

## Features

- Event Registration (Weddings, Festivals, Parties, etc.)
- Business Listings (Catering, Vendors, Services)
- Job Listings
- News Section
- User Profiles & Authentication
- Event Search & Filtering
- Business Ratings & Reviews
